_comment: The ONLY catalogues the index will ever ask. Nothing outside this list is contacted, and
adding a source is a deliberate act — it is an extension of trust, not a convenience.
Official sources first, on purpose: source_tier() reads github.com/anthropics/skills as
Tier 1, and everything here still passes through the same audit before anything installs.
What is fetched is ONE file per source: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. It is DATA — a list
of names and descriptions to match against — and it is never handed to an agent as text to
act on. Nothing is cloned, nothing is executed, and being in the index grants a skill nothing.
